description: American direct-to-consumer eyewear brand selling prescription glasses, sunglasses and contacts online and in its own stores, known for its home try-on program and fashion-led frame designs.

evidence.summary: Lasso lists the Warby Parker affiliate program at up to 20% per sale with a 45-day cookie, in the eyewear and fashion categories, with the join route via ShareASale. No earnings-cap statement appears in the program material reviewed, so the cap is honestly unknown, not uncapped.

Lasso describes Warby Parker as a stylish, affordable eyewear brand with a strong digital presence and loyal customer base that invites content creators and marketers to partner with it - a natural fit for eyewear try-on and frame-styling content.

name: Warby Parker

reasons.compensation: Up to 20% per sale is one of the strongest published rates in fashion accessories, with a 45-day cookie.
reasons.contact_access: Open application through ShareASale; no public affiliate email was verified.
reasons.credibility: Major listed US eyewear retailer with national store footprint.
reasons.niche_fit: Eyewear is a core fashion accessory and Warby Parker's frames are built for try-on and styling content.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The program actively invites content creators and marketers to partner; home try-on is a proven UGC format.

description: Portland, Oregon leather goods company that grew from a small Etsy shop into a fast-growing maker of full-grain leather handbags, totes, backpacks and footwear sold through its own website and stores.

evidence.summary: Portland Leather Goods' own Awin merchant profile (US, merchant 44997) states a 9% default commission and a 30-day cookie, and gives the affiliate team contact as makenna@porotlandleathergoods.com - spelled exactly that way on the profile. The profile also notes a private Facebook group of over 50,000 active members. No earnings-cap statement appears, so the cap is unknown.

The brand's own Instagram post promotes its creator affiliate program: apply to join the 'PLG Crew' (reviewed in 2-3 business days), receive a discount and custom referral link, and earn commission sharing bags on Instagram, TikTok and beyond; commenters discuss a 5,000-follower threshold. A creator post reports a second route via Roster at 13% commission with tiers up to 17%.

A widely shared marketing breakdown reports Portland Leather recruited roughly 500 fan affiliates who produced about 3,800 videos - creator scale in the hundreds, which under the directory standard is honestly unknown saturation, not low.

name: Portland Leather Goods

reasons.compensation: 9% default on Awin, with a creator route reported at 13% rising to 17% in tiers.
reasons.contact_access: Named affiliate-team email published on the brand's own Awin profile, plus a public creator application.
reasons.credibility: Established US maker with its own stores and a large verified social following.
reasons.niche_fit: Handbags, totes and leather accessories are core fashion content, and the bags are heavily featured in travel and everyday-carry posts.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open Awin program plus an actively promoted creator crew.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A named creator program with an application, a 50,000-member fan group and hundreds of fan affiliates making thousands of videos.

description: American sightseeing pass company selling bundled, discounted admission to top attractions in 15+ North American cities including New York, Chicago, San Francisco and Seattle.

evidence.summary: Lasso lists the CityPASS affiliate program at 6% per sale with a 90-day cookie in the travel category. No earnings-cap statement was found, so the cap is unknown.

CityPASS's own media FAQ confirms the CityPASS affiliate program is available through CJ: after joining the CJ network, affiliates receive a unique tracking link to citypass.com and earn commission on each sale it originates (some pass products, including New York C3 and Toronto, are excluded).

Commission Academy's CJ program details (CJ Advertiser ID 2805705) give city-tiered rates: 6% on most CityPASS cities, 5% on Philadelphia and Denver, 4% on San Diego and $1 flat on Southern California and Orlando passes, with a 90-day cookie and monthly payouts managed by CJ.

name: CityPASS

reasons.compensation: 6% on most cities with an unusually long 90-day cookie; a few cities pay 4-5% or a $1 flat rate.
reasons.contact_access: Program confirmed and linked from the brand's own media FAQ; application runs through CJ.
reasons.credibility: Operating since 1997 with partnerships at major US attractions.
reasons.niche_fit: City sightseeing passes map directly onto travel itinerary and city-guide content.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Continuously open CJ program across 15+ cities.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Open CJ program promoted to travel bloggers; the brand confirms the program on its own media site.
